title: Training/Education Spec.
description:
Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72\+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.


**A Day in the Life**
=====================

Are you passionate about advancing healthcare professional education and helping clinical teams deliver better outcomes for patients with aortic disease? Join Medtronic's Aortic business as a Training \& Education Specialist supporting the Mediterranean Cluster (Italy, Greece, Israel). You will help design, coordinate and execute educational initiatives that enable healthcare professionals to build endovascular knowledge, procedural confidence and effective team\-based practice.
  

  

This hybrid role combines regional program coordination with field\-based execution across the Mediterranean Cluster as well as on Western European level. You will collaborate with country commercial teams, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Clinical, Compliance and regional Medical Education colleagues, as well as external faculty and training centers. Regular travel is required to support customer education events, hands\-on workshops, congress activities and strategic initiatives. The role is part of the Aortic Training \& Education organization; the formal reporting location and travel expectation will be confirmed during recruitment.
**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**

· Coordinate and deliver healthcare professional education programs, workshops, fellowships, webinars and blended learning activities across the Mediterranean Cluster and Western Europe


· Manage end\-to\-end program preparation, including needs assessment, project planning, faculty coordination, participant communication, logistics, materials, compliance documentation and post\-event follow\-up


· Partner with Marketing, Sales, Clinical, Medical Affairs and Compliance to ensure educational activities address customer needs and align with business, quality and regulatory requirements


· Build productive relationships with healthcare professionals, external faculty, training centers and internal stakeholders across different countries and cultures


· Support education related to Medtronic aortic therapies, including the Endurant™ Stent Graft System, a minimally invasive endovascular device used in the treatment of abdominal aortic aneurysms (AAA) and ValiantTM thoracic stent graft with CaptiviaTM delivery system.


· Monitor participation, feedback, learning outcomes and program execution data, and translate insights into practical improvements for future activities


· Contribute to regional congress activities, educational content development, budget tracking and strategic Medical Education projects  



**Required Knowledge and Experience:**

· Bachelor's degree in life sciences, healthcare, biomedical engineering, education, business or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant experience


· Experience in medical education, clinical education, professional training, healthcare event management or a comparable customer\-facing role


· Demonstrated project management and organizational skills, with the ability to coordinate multiple programs, stakeholders and deadlines


· Clear written and verbal communication skills in Italian and English; confidence working across countries and cultures


· Experience working with healthcare professionals (HCPs) and an understanding of compliance requirements for healthcare professional engagement


· Ability and willingness to travel regularly within the Mediterranean Cluster (and occasionally in Western Europe), together with proficiency in Microsoft 365 and digital collaboration tools

Director, Technical Operations Strategy, Execution \& Transformation
  
  

Alfasigma is a privately held global healthcare company founded over 75 years ago in Italy, where it remains headquartered today in Bologna and Milan. The Group operates in over 100 markets spanning Europe, North and South America, Asia, and Africa.
  
  

Over three years ago, we embarked on a transformative journey to become a truly global innovative healthcare company with a leading focus on Gastrointestinal (GI) health. We have experienced remarkable growth, nearly doubled our revenues, expanding geographically, and integrating several key acquisitions. We have also evolved our portfolio, expanded into rare and specialty segments, and strengthened our pipeline and people's capabilities.
  
  

But our journey is far from complete! In fact, this is just the beginning of a bold new chapter in Alfasigma's history. We are committed to advancing innovation and leveraging our deep expertise to provide better health and a better quality of life for patients and consumers worldwide and expand our reach across diverse markets.
  
  

Scope of the role
  
  

The Technical Operations (TechOps) Strategy, Execution \& Transformation Director is responsible for leading the governance and execution of the Technical Operations strategic portfolio, ensuring alignment between corporate strategy and operational delivery across a complex global manufacturing network.
  
  

Reporting directly to the Chief Technical Operations Officer, the role oversees a portfolio of transformation, operational excellence, network optimization, capacity expansion, product launch, and integration initiatives across internal manufacturing sites and external partners (CDMOs). The incumbent drives portfolio governance, resource prioritization, investment planning, and cross\-functional coordination to ensure the successful delivery of strategic objectives while maximizing business value.
  
  

As a key advisor to the CTOO and Executive Leadership Team, the Director provides visibility into portfolio performance, risks, dependencies, and investment decisions, while leading a team of Project Managers and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement. The role may also directly manage selected critical strategic projects when required.
  
  

Success in this position requires strong leadership, stakeholder management, financial acumen, and a deep understanding of pharmaceutical operations, combined with expertise in Lean principles and transformation methodologies.
  
  

Your Role
  
Program \& Portfolio Management
  
Manage strategic or highly complex projects directly when required.
  
Partner with business leaders to support organizational readiness, stakeholder engagement, and adoption of strategic initiatives.
  
Ensure project deliverables meet business objectives, compliance requirements, and operational expectations.
  
Drive measurable business outcomes through the successful delivery of strategic initiatives.
  
Identify, evaluate, and prioritize projects within the portfolio in alignment with corporate strategy and stakeholder expectations.
  
Continuously assess and optimize the portfolio to reflect changing business priorities, risks, opportunities, and operational needs.
  
Define program roadmaps, governance structures, KPIs, and reporting mechanisms.
  
Ensure effective allocation and optimization of resources and investment expenditures.
  
Coordinate execution across multiple manufacturing and technical sites.
  
Identify, monitor, and proactively manage dependencies across programs, sites, and functions to minimize delivery risks.
  
Maintain an integrated portfolio view, highlighting interdependencies, cumulative impacts, resource constraints, and opportunities for synergy.
  
Facilitate trade\-off decisions when priorities, timelines, or resource requirements compete.
  
Project Governance \& Execution
  
Maintain, enhance, and standardize project and program management practices across the organization.
  
Ensure all projects are supported by robust feasibility assessments and business cases before approval.
  
Implement governance frameworks that enable timely and informed decision\-making while maintaining quality, compliance, and oversight.
  
Monitor and report business benefits throughout the program lifecycle to ensure strategic investments achieve intended outcomes.
  
Provide regular updates to executive leadership on project progress, financial performance, risks, and mitigation plans.
  
Ensure project management tools, methodologies, and systems are effectively deployed and continuously improved.
  
Drive continuous improvement initiatives related to governance, project execution, and portfolio management processes.
  
Partner with Finance to assess investment requirements, monitor portfolio expenditures, and provide financial analyses to support prioritization and strategic decisions.
  
Who You Are
  
Education
  
Master's degree in Engineering, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
  
Project Management and/or Program Management certification is preferred.
  
Experience
  
Minimum of 10 years of experience in Program and Project Management.
  
Proven track record of leading complex, international, and cross\-functional portfolios.
  
Demonstrated experience managing interdependencies, competing priorities, and resource conflicts across organizational boundaries.
  
Experience acting as a trusted advisor to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.
  
Proven leadership experience managing Project Managers and multidisciplinary teams.
  
Experience within the pharmaceutical, biotech, healthcare, manufacturing, or similarly regulated industries is highly desirable.
  
Technical \& Professional Skills
  
Strong knowledge of Program and Portfolio Management methodologies.
  
Advanced financial acumen, including portfolio budgeting, investment evaluation, forecasting, cost management, and financial impact assessment.
  
Demonstrated ability to identify, integrate, and manage dependencies across programs, functions, sites, and external partners.
  
Strong analytical, organizational, and problem\-solving capabilities.
  
Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
  
Ability to leverage digital portfolio management tools, data analytics, and emerging technologies to enhance reporting, visibility, and decision\-making.
  
Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced and international environment.
  
Solid understanding of Lean Management principles and continuous improvement methodologies.
  
Leadership Competencies
  
Strategic thinking and business alignment.
  
Cross\-functional collaboration and partnership building.
  
Influencing and stakeholder engagement.
  
Consensus building and negotiation across competing priorities.
  
Team leadership and talent development.
  
Decision\-making and accountability.
  
Continuous improvement mindset.
  
Results orientation.
  
Change management and organizational agility.
  
Key Relationships
  
  

Build effective delivery partnerships across Engineering, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, Facilities \& EHS, CDMOs, and other relevant functions to align dependencies, resolve competing priorities, and drive successful end\-to\-end program delivery.
  
  

Pay range 95\.000€ \- 120\.000€

The final remuneration will be determined based on the selected candidate’s experience, skills, and qualifications, in accordance with applicable EU pay transparency and pay equity requirements

title: Clinical Field Service Engineer
description:
Overview:
* Are you looking for an impactful role within a growing business that helps advance science and improve human health?
* Would you enjoy the freedom of a field\-based role where no two days are the same and you can become a trusted technical partner to our customers?
* Are you looking for opportunities to grow, develop, learn and progress in your career?
* Would you like to join a global, innovative technology organisation that is strongly committed to diversity, equity and inclusion?


If your answers are yes, then we would love to hear from you!  

At Waters, we design and manufacture innovative products, solutions and services that help our customers solve important scientific challenges. Our people make a real difference through their work. They are passionate about what they do, proud of their accomplishments and central to making Waters a great place to work.  

As a **Clinical Field Service Engineer**, you will support customers operating Waters LC\-MS systems within regulated clinical laboratory environments. This is a varied and rewarding field\-based role in which you will install, maintain and repair analytical systems, solve technical problems and build trusted relationships with the customers you support. No two days will be the same.  

As a global organisation, Waters offers a wide range of opportunities to learn, grow and develop. Many of our team members have progressed within Field Service or moved into other areas of the business, including applications support, sales, global technical support and leadership.  


Responsibilities:
**So, what does a Clinical Field Service Engineer do? Below are some of the key responsibilities:*** Install, qualify, calibrate, maintain, troubleshoot and repair Waters LC\-MS systems within regulated clinical laboratory environments.
* Analyse system performance and diagnostic data to identify the source of technical problems and determine the appropriate corrective action.
* Work closely with our wider technical and support teams to resolve issues efficiently, escalating more complex problems when required.
* Manage customer expectations by clearly communicating the work performed and providing follow\-up plans where required.
* Complete service records and other required documentation accurately and promptly, in accordance with Waters’ quality and regulatory procedures.
* Build strong relationships with customers, providing appropriate advice and support on Waters products and services while identifying opportunities to further improve their laboratory operations.


To help you succeed, you will receive comprehensive technical training, support from an experienced team and access to continuous learning and development opportunities throughout your career at Waters.
Qualifications:
**Who are we looking for?** **Education:*** A minimum bachelor’s degree in analytical chemistry, biology, physics, engineering or a related scientific or technical discipline is essential.

**Experience:*** Practical experience working with complex analytical or laboratory instrumentation.
* Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, fluidic and software\-related issues.
* Experience maintaining, calibrating or troubleshooting analytical instrumentation would be advantageous.
* Previous experience using or servicing LC\-MS instrumentation, preferably Waters systems, is strongly preferred.
* Experience within a clinical, forensic, hospital, IVD or other regulated laboratory environment would be advantageous.
* A valid driving licence in good standing is mandatory.
* Willingness to undertake overnight travel when required, including international travel for technical training.

**Skills:*** A strong customer focus and commitment to delivering excellent service.
* A logical and analytical approach to troubleshooting and problem\-solving.
* Strong communication skills and the ability to communicate effectively with customers and colleagues from different technical backgrounds.
* The ability to manage time effectively, organise field activities and work independently.
* A collaborative approach and willingness to work with wider technical and support teams.
* A strong sense of personal integrity and accountability
* Fluent Italian and a good professional command of spoken and written English, equivalent to at least B2 under the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). The role requires regular communication with an English\-speaking manager and international colleagues, as well as participation in technical training delivered in English.

 **Frequent overnight travel may be required.**  

Waters recognises that people from some backgrounds remain under\-represented within STEM careers and may face barriers during the application process. As an inclusive employer, we welcome applications from everyone. You do not need to meet every desirable requirement of the role. If you believe you can add value to our business, we want to hear from you.
Company Description:

Waters Corporation (NYSE:WAT) is a global leader in life sciences and diagnostics, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high\-volume testing environments, our innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across chemistry, physics, and biology. We collaborate with customers around the world to advance the release of effective, high\-quality medicines, ensure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combating antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, our passionate team of \~16,000 colleagues turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide.  

  

Within Waters’ Advanced Diagnostics group, the Clinical LC\-MS Service team supports analytical systems used in regulated clinical laboratory environments. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and consider all qualified applicants without discrimination based on any characteristic protected by applicable law. All hiring decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business needs.*

description:
From day one at Unobravo, we’ve been **on a mission to make mental health support truly accessible to everyone** by normalizing therapy, fostering openness, and breaking down the stigma that still surrounds it.  

Our success is driven by an exceptional team dedicated to providing high\-quality, accessible care, anytime, anywhere. With over 9,500 qualified therapists and more than 10 million therapy sessions delivered, **we’re proud to have made a meaningful difference in countless lives.**


To take our company to the next level, we're looking for a **VP of Technology \& Product** to lead the next chapter of our Technology \& Product organisation.


We're looking for a **technically credible, product\-minded leader** who combines strategic thinking with pragmatic execution and leads with **trust, strong leadership and low ego**.

**Reporting to the COO**, you'll lead **Engineering, Product and Design** across an organisation of \~**50 people**, bringing these disciplines together around a shared strategy while empowering their respective leaders.


You'll also play a **key role in driving Unobravo's responsible adoption of AI and emerging technologies**, identifying opportunities to create meaningful value while ensuring innovation remains grounded in **clinical integrity, user trust, safety and regulatory requirements**.


Unobravo is first and foremost a **mental health company**. Technology enables our mission; this role will ensure Product and Technology can deliver it **responsibly and at scale**.

### **The Essentials**

* **Preferred Location:** Milan\-based. As a senior leadership role, we expect regular in\-person presence in our Milan office (2/3 days/week) recognising the value of face\-to\-face collaboration at this level.
* **Salary range:** Starting from €100,000 gross annual base salary, with the final package determined based on experience and scope, in line with our commitment to transparent and equitable compensation practices.

### **What You'll Do**

* **Strategy \& Prioritisation**: Driving an integrated technology strategy that serves both patients and therapists, translates company priorities into clear direction and roadmaps and balances user needs, clinical impact, business value, scalability and long\-term sustainability.
* **Cross\-Functional Leadership**: Creating the conditions for Engineering, Product and Design to operate as a cohesive, outcome\-oriented organisation.
* **Executive Communication \& Influence**: Representing Technology and Product at leadership level, translating complex trade\-offs, constraints and risks into clear business implications and advocating for the investments needed to support the company over the long term.
* **Technology Scalability \& Reliability**: Ensuring Unobravo operates a scalable, secure and reliable technology platform capable of supporting our long\-term ambitions.
* **Pragmatic Engineering Culture**: Fostering a pragmatic engineering culture that values simplicity, maintainability and impact over unnecessary complexity or hype\-driven technology decisions.
* **Technical Sustainability**: Balancing speed and innovation with technical sustainability, including the effective management of technical debt, architecture and platform evolution.
* **AI Strategy \& Governance**: Shaping and championing the organisation’s AI strategy and culture, influencing how teams adopt, experiment with and embed AI into their ways of working, while establishing appropriate governance and ensuring alignment with clinical, ethical, security and regulatory standards.
* **Leadership \& Talent Development**: Leading, coaching and developing senior leaders across Engineering, Product and Design, creating strong functional leadership while fostering collaboration across disciplines.
* **Low\-Ego Culture \& Ownership**: Building a low\-ego culture where teams have meaningful ownership, people can challenge decisions openly and the best ideas win regardless of hierarchy.
* **Customer\-Centred Delivery**: Ensuring teams deliver meaningful value through customer insight, experimentation, data\-informed iteration and high\-quality execution.

### **️ YOU WILL BE THE PERFECT FIT IF YOU HAVE:**

### **Technology \& Product Leadership**

* Significant **leadership experience within Engineering or Technology**, with meaningful responsibility for Product and cross\-functional product development organisations.
* A **strong technical foundation** and credibility, with the ability to **understand architecture, challenge technical decisions** and evaluate technology trade\-offs without undermining team ownership.
* Strong **product judgement** and the ability to balance customer value, business priorities, engineering sustainability and speed of execution.
* A track record of **delivering successful digital products** and **scaling technology organisations** in high\-growth environments.
* Experience in **regulated or highly trust\-sensitive environments** such as healthcare, fintech or other data\-sensitive platforms is highly valued.

### **Organisational \& People Leadership**

* Proven experience **leading and developing leaders**, building high\-performing teams and evolving organisations as they scale.
* A l**ow\-ego leadership style** characterised by intellectual humility, curiosity, direct communication and a genuine commitment to **enabling others to succeed**.
* The ability to **create clarity and accountability** while giving leaders and teams meaningful autonomy.

### **Business \& Executive Leadership**

* Strong **business acumen** and the ability to connect **Technology** and **Product** decisions to broader company outcomes.
* Demonstrated **ability to influence senior stakeholders**, communicate complexity simply and advocate for **long\-term technology needs** in business terms.
* The confidence to **challenge decisions** constructively and stand behind Product and Technology needs when they serve the company's long\-term interests.
* Strong **strategic thinking** combined with the **pragmatism** to know when good enough is better than perfect.

### **AI \& Responsible Innovation**

* Strong u**nderstanding of AI** and **emerging technologies** and the ability to identify where they can create **meaningful value** for users and the business.
* Experience navigating the **ethical, security, governance or regulatory considerations** associated with technology and AI adoption.
* A **thoughtful approach** to innovation that balances opportunity with **Unobravo's responsibility towards patients, therapists and their data.**

### **Power\-Ups**

* Experience leading or partnering closely with **Design** and **Research** functions.
* Experience operating in a **European regulatory environment**.
* Experience **scaling** organisations across **multiple markets.**

***Not everyone checks every box, and that’s okay. If this role inspires you and you’re passionate about making an impact in our mission, we’d love to hear from you***

### **What we offer**

 **Scaling with purpose**  

Step into a work environment that's in **constant motion**, and **ever\-evolving**. Be part of a company that's on the rise!  

  

**Everyone Needs Unobravo**  

Your mental health matters. Get access to **exclusive discounts on psychotherapy sessions** with our professionals: your well\-being comes first.

Enjoy unforgettable**company retreats**,**team\-building**experiences, nationwide **aperitivo parties**and more.. Because we love celebrating milestones together!

We speak your language, and want you to speak ours! Enjoy a **free membership and conversation courses** on our language platform to grow personally and professionally.

title: Finance Manager
description:
**Requisition ID:** 72615

**About Whirlpool Corporation**

  

Whirlpool Corporation (NYSE: WHR) is a leading home appliance company, in constant  

pursuit of improving life at home. As the only major U.S.\-based manufacturer of kitchen  

and laundry appliances, the company is driving meaningful innovation to meet the evolving  

needs of consumers through its iconic brand portfolio, including Whirlpool, KitchenAid,  

JennAir, Maytag, Amana, Brastemp, Consul, and InSinkErator. In 2025, the company reported  

approximately $16 billion in annual net sales \- close to 90% of which were in the Americas \-  

41,000 employees, and 35 manufacturing and technology research centers. Additional  

information about the company can be found at WhirlpoolCorp.com.

**The team you will be a part of**
----------------------------------


The Accounting team establishes and maintains accounting policies and controls, fiscal controls, preparing financial reports and safeguarding the organization's assets. Maintains accounting and financial records and reports, including general ledger, financial statements, regulatory and management reports.**This role in summary**
------------------------



The Finance Manager will take 100% independent ownership of all day\-to\-day accounting, statutory, fiscal, and regulatory tasks for our Italian legal entity at our Mercallo site. As the entity navigates its next strategic lifecycle phase, this professional will ensure local compliance, manage regulatory filings, oversee the transition of operational activities, and maintain robust financial governance.


This role reports directly to Luxembourg\-based finance leadership and offers an excellent opportunity to manage complex corporate compliance and entity restructuring processes.


**Your responsibilities will include**
--------------------------------------



More specifically, the main tasks and responsibilities will include:

* *Entity Governance \& Compliance:* Manage the end\-to\-end statutory, regulatory, and fiscal lifecycle obligations of the Italian legal entity, ensuring full compliance with local authorities during transitional phases.
* *Financial \& Statutory Accounting*: Lead day\-to\-day accounting, review accruals, and supervise corporate financial records. Prepare annual financial statements under Italian GAAP.
* *Global Reporting Alignment:* Deliver accurate monthly and quarterly financial reporting inputs to the US parent company, adapting local financial data to group requirements.
* *Tax \& Treasury Oversight:* Coordinate annual tax return compliance (in partnership with our outsourced tax provider). Oversee the preparation and submission of VAT returns, statistical returns, and serve as the final monthly reviewer for F24 forms (vendors and remaining payroll allocations).
* *Audit \& Closure Readiness:* Coordinate external audit processes, prepare comprehensive external audit deliverables, and systematically archive financial records to support long\-term compliance requirements.
* *Cash Flow Management:* Coordinate entity cash flow availability, weekly forecasting, intercompany cost rebills, and intercompany reconciliations. Provide financial projections and interim accounts for group\-wide entity management projects.
**Minimum requirements**
------------------------


* *Experience \& Profile:* We are seeking candidates with 3–5 years of experience at the finance or accounting manager level, with at least five years of total relevant accounting experience.
* *Italian GAAP Expertise:* A profound understanding of Italian GAAP statutory regulations, local tax compliance, and legal entity requirements is mandatory.
* *US GAAP \& Training:* Prior experience with US GAAP is not required. The group will provide the necessary training and support to help the successful candidate adapt local records to corporate US reporting structures.
* *Language Skills:* Fluency in both Italian and English is mandatory. The hiring manager is based in Luxembourg; therefore, your CV must be submitted in English, and all interviews will be conducted in English.
* *Autonomy \& Resilience:* A proven self\-starter who can operate with minimal local supervision, manage tight institutional deadlines.
* *Location \& Contract:* Ability to work on\-site out of our Mercallo (VA) location under a 1\-year fixed\-term structure.
* *Tech Proficiency:* Advanced knowledge of SAP, or other ERP system, and Microsoft Office (Excel) is required.
**What we offer**
-----------------



Join our well\-structured and consolidated team, where collaboration and excellence are deeply valued. You'll thrive in an international environment offering global career opportunities. Enjoy a supportive team spirit and positive atmosphere that fosters growth and innovation.


The anticipated salary range for this position is €58000 \- € 70\.000\. Final compensation within this range will be determined based on several factors, including the candidate’s relevant skills, professional experience, and specific educational background and certifications.

  

Connect with us and learn more about Whirlpool Corporation


See what it's like to work at Whirlpool by visiting Whirlpool Careers. Additional information about the company can be found on Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube.


Whirlpool Corporation is committed to equal employment opportunity and prohibits any discrimination on the basis of race or ethnicity, religion, sex, pregnancy, gender expression or identity, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, veteran status, or any other category protected by applicable law.

The role acts as the single operational integrator at Asset level, coordinating activities and ensuring follow\-through, without owning final decisions on asset strategy, external toller siting, or internal manufacturing allocation.

* Ensure unresolved issues are properly escalated and tracked to closure

* Translate Asset priorities into executable supply, manufacturing, regulatory and inventory plans
* Coordinate cross\-functional execution across Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Regulatory, and Quality

* External Tolling \& Internal Manufacturing Coordination
* Act as the operational Asset interface toward Global Supply Chain and Internal Manufacturing
* Provide operational input to Global Supply Chain to support siting decisions
* Coordinate with Regional Manufacturing Heads on internal execution and capacity alignment

* Supply, Inventory \& Performance Management
* Drive execution of approved inventory and safety stock strategies
* Support allocation scenarios during supply constraints
* Monitor and explain key operational variances (service, PPV, LCR) 5\. Quality \& Issue Management
* Coordinate major quality or operational issues at Asset level
* Ensure structured escalation, corrective action follow\-up, and closure 6\. Cross\-Functional Integration
* Act as the Asset\-level operational integrator across all relevant functions
* Ensure decisions are documented, executed, and reviewed for effectiveness

**Key Competencies**

* Strong capability to lead and structure Asset\-level S\&OP processes, ensuring disciplined execution and decision\-making
* Deep understanding of planning processes and tools, including ERP systems and data structures, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights
* High execution focus with strong follow\-through, ensuring alignment, escalation, and closure of operational actions
* Strong business acumen, with ability to balance service, cost, and inventory trade\-offs and provide clear operational recommendations
* Ability to influence and drive alignment across cross\-functional teams without direct authority (Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Regulatory)

* Regulatory: alignment on regulatory changes impacting supply, formulation, or product availability
* Planning (Global/Regional): coordination of demand, supply plans, and S\&OP cycles to ensure alignment between planning and execution

* Service Level / OTIF for assigned Assets (global and regional view)
* Lost sales or back orders due to product non\-availability
* Inventory level vs target and safety stock adherence
* Inventory aging and obsolescence exposure
* Purchase Price Variance (PPV) and key drivers impacting cost performance
* Margin performance vs budget or prior year (where influenced by operational execution)
* Premium freight / expedite cost as indicator of execution stability
* Production and supply plan adherence (internal sites and tollers)
* Resolution time for major operational or quality issues
* Closure rate of escalations and action items
* S\&OP effectiveness indicators (process adherence, forecast reliability, alignment between plan and execution)

DATA4 creates Smart \& Scalable digital facilities for our customers. Our network of highly connected, resilient and sustainable data center campuses underpins our customers’ digital growth in Europe.



DATA4 Group finances, designs, constructs and operates its own data centers. Delivered through our data center campus model, we provide our customers with secure, scalable and high\-performance data hosting solutions.

  


**DATA4 VALUES**



At DATA4 we are driven by our values. These are the core of everything we do – from the proactivity we show in delivering great outcomes for our clients, to the responsibility we show as a key contributor to the digital economy. Our three values are:



* **To be entrepreneurial** – we are teams of doers who make things happen \- with autonomy, energy and a sense of responsibility


* **To always take responsibility** – for our impact on the people we work with, the society we are part of, and the environment in which we operate


* **To constantly be adaptable** – our business is designed to adapt, answering not only today’s challenges, but also anticipating what’s coming next.
  


**ABOUT THE ROLE**



We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Data Center Civils, Structural and Architectural (CSA) Lead to join our Engineering department. This transversal role focuses on leading all CSA aspects of data center design and construction projects. You will provide technical expertise, develop conceptual designs, oversee handover processes, represent the company in project meetings, and ensure the smooth implementation of CSA. The role will also focus on developing Global CSA standards and ensuring these are implemented on projects. This will also involve significant amount of work with Key internal and external stakeholders (including Clients) to develop CSA solutions.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES**


**Design Leadership \& Product Ownership**

  

* Act as the discipline owner for CSA engineering within the Engineering organisation.
* Lead the development and continuous improvement of DATA4 CSA design standards across all European campuses.
* Define and maintain design principles, technical specifications, standard details and approved solutions for data centre developments.
* Provide technical leadership during feasibility studies, due diligence activities and campus master planning exercises.
* Support the development of scalable and repeatable data centre products while driving consistency across projects and geographies.
* Ensure CSA designs align with operational, commercial, sustainability and customer requirements.

  


**Conceptual \& Detailed Design**


* Lead CSA design development for new campuses, expansions and retrofit projects.
* Review and approve conceptual, schematic, developed and detailed designs prepared by external consultants.
* Ensure designs achieve the required levels of resilience, safety, functionality, flexibility and operational efficiency.
* Evaluate structural systems, building envelopes, site development strategies, road networks, utilities interfaces and underground infrastructure.
* Coordinate interfaces between architectural, civil, structural, mechanical, electrical, controls and commissioning disciplines.

  


**Technical Governance \& Assurance**

* Review consultant submissions and verify compliance with company standards, project requirements and applicable regulations.
* Ensure consistency of engineering solutions across multiple projects and countries.
* Support risk identification, mitigation and resolution related to CSA systems.

  


**Construction \& Project Support**


* Provide technical support during construction activities across multiple projects.
* Support project teams in resolving complex design, site and construction challenges.
* Review contractor proposals, value engineering initiatives and technical deviations.
* Participate in site inspections, quality audits and progress reviews.

  


**Stakeholder Management \& Representation**


* Act as the primary CSA engineering representative within the organisation.
* Collaborate with internal departments including Development, Construction, Operations, Procurement, Sustainability and Commercial teams.
* Manage relationships with external engineering consultants, architects, contractors and specialist suppliers.
* Represent DATA4 during technical meetings, design workshops, regulatory discussions and customer engagements.
* Communicate complex technical matters clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

  


**Continuous Improvement \& Innovation**


* Monitor industry trends, technologies, materials and construction methodologies relevant to data centre development.
* Identify opportunities to optimise cost, programme, sustainability, scalability and operational performance.
* Lead the implementation of innovative design approaches and best practices.
* Analyse project feedback and lessons learned to continuously improve standards and processes.
* Contribute to sustainability initiatives, embodied carbon reduction strategies and circular economy objectives.

* **H\&S:** Respect and enforce health and safety rules.
* **Environment:** Respect and enforce environmental policies.
* **Information security:** Respect and enforce information security policies
* **Energy:** Respect and enforce the policy of reducing energy consumption.

  


**REQUIREMENTS**

**Senior Project Manager – Power Services**

**United Kingdom \| Additional locations: Belgium, Czech Republic, Ireland, the Netherlands, Poland and Switzerland**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Do you want to lead technically complex projects that improve and extend the performance of power\-generation equipment across Europe?


GE Vernova is looking for an experienced Senior Project Manager to join our Power Services team. You can be based in the United Kingdom or one of our locations in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Ireland, the Netherlands, Poland or Switzerland.


**\-**
------


**GE Vernova – The Energy to Change the World**
-----------------------------------------------


With over 130 years of experience and proven innovation, GE Vernova is leading a new era of energy. We are electrifying the world while working to decarbonize it. Our name reflects our mission. “GE” carries a legacy of quality and ingenuity. “Ver” signals Earth’s lush ecosystems, while “Nova” nods to a new era of lower\-carbon energy we are helping to deliver.


Focused on the future, GE Vernova is accelerating the shift to reliable, affordable and sustainable energy. We help customers power economies and deliver electricity vital to health, safety and quality of life.


**\-**
------


**Power**
---------


Our Power portfolio provides sustainable, more efficient energy solutions. With expertise across Gas, Hydro, Nuclear and Steam Power, we help customers deliver electricity to homes, industries and communities worldwide.


**\-**
------


**Let’s Talk About the Role**
-----------------------------


As Senior Project Manager, you will lead the delivery of complex aftermarket projects within our Power Services organisation, acting as GE Vernova’s principal representative and the customer’s main point of contact throughout the project lifecycle.


The projects will typically involve Conversions, Modifications and Upgrades (CM\&Us), rehabilitation or relocation activities on existing brownfield power\-generation sites. They may cover industrial heavy\-duty and aero\-derivative gas turbines, steam turbines, generators, Heat Recovery Steam Generators and associated balance\-of\-plant equipment.


You will take ownership of project execution, bringing together engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, planning and site teams to deliver safely, contractually and profitably. These projects can require extensive design work, full technical integration and, in some cases, the introduction of new products or solutions. Strong scope, change, cost and design control will therefore be essential.


Depending on their size and complexity, you may manage several projects concurrently in a fast\-paced, highly visible international environment.


**\-**
------


**How You Will Make a Difference**
----------------------------------


* **Leading** the execution of complex conversion, modification, upgrade, rehabilitation and relocation projects, ensuring that contractual, cost, schedule, quality and EHS commitments are achieved.
* **Acting** as GE Vernova’s principal representative and focal point for the customer, building trusted relationships and driving the resolution of customer issues.
* **Supporting** the offer and tendering phase by contributing execution experience, identifying gaps and helping to ensure that the proposed fulfilment strategy is practical and robust.
* **Defining and implementing** the project execution strategy, challenging assumptions and ensuring that projects are set up for successful delivery.
* **Coordinating** cross\-functional teams across engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics, planning and site execution.
* **Driving** project schedules in partnership with project planners, maintaining visibility of milestones, dependencies and recovery actions.
* **Managing** project financial performance, including cost, forecasts, margin, invoicing, receivables and risk provisions.
* **Interpreting and applying** contractual terms and conditions throughout project execution.
* **Managing** project scope, changes, risks, opportunities and claims, escalating matters when necessary while maintaining ownership of the resolution.
* **Providing** clear project\-status updates and leading project reviews with customers, regional teams, the PMO and senior management.
* **Capturing and sharing** lessons learned, best practices and Cost of Poor Quality cases to improve future project delivery.
* **Following** the relevant Power Services and CM\&U project\-management processes.

**\-**
------


**Special Role Requirements**
-----------------------------


* Willingness and ability to travel approximately 20%, predominantly within Europe.
* Ability to work effectively across different countries, cultures and time zones.

**\-**


**Skills for Success**
----------------------


You will be an experienced project leader with a strong record of delivering complex, customer\-facing projects within power generation, energy services or a closely related technical environment.


You will bring:


* Substantial experience managing complex, large\-scale turnkey or service projects, ideally within power generation.
* Experience delivering projects involving upgrades, conversions, modifications, rehabilitation, outages or comparable brownfield activities.
* Sufficient technical understanding to work effectively with engineering teams and understand the equipment and solutions being delivered at customer sites.
* Strong customer\-management skills and the confidence to resolve complex issues and escalations.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional and international teams across engineering, sourcing, manufacturing, logistics and site execution.
* Understanding of project financials, including cost, margin, forecasting, invoicing and cash.
* Experience interpreting and applying contracts, managing scope changes and supporting claims or commercial negotiations.
* Strong organisational and analytical skills, with the ability to manage several active priorities and maintain momentum in a demanding environment.
* The ability to influence stakeholders and lead matrix teams without relying on direct authority.
* Cultural awareness and the ability to build effective relationships across an international organisation.
* A commitment to continuous improvement and sharing lessons learned.

**\-**
------


**Qualifications**
------------------


* A bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business or another relevant technical or business\-related discipline.
* PMP, PMLP or another recognised project\-management qualification is preferred.
* Strong candidates who do not currently hold the required project\-management certification may be supported in obtaining it within an agreed period following appointment.
* Willingness to complete the ongoing training and recertification required to maintain the appropriate PMO Project Manager qualification status.

**\-**
------


**Where and How You’ll Work**
-----------------------------


This is a permanent position with the United Kingdom as the primary location. The successful candidate may alternatively be based in Belgium, the Czech Republic, Ireland, the Netherlands, Poland or Switzerland.


Working arrangements will depend on the selected location. Where a suitable GE Vernova office is available, a flexible hybrid arrangement can be agreed. Where there is no nearby office, home\-based working may be considered.


**\-**
------


**Our Culture**
---------------


Every action shapes our future. That's why our north star is a culture of impact, where everyone is empowered to thrive and achieve.


Addressing the urgent need to build a more sustainable electric power system while improving the trajectory of climate change emissions are global priorities, and we take our responsibility seriously. That is our mission at GE Vernova: continuing to electrify to thrive and decarbonize the world. We play a significant role in leading a new era of energy.


Our technology helps generate approximately twenty\-five percent of the world's electricity today, and we are working to power the rest. If we want the future of energy to be different, then join us and be the difference. Together, we are the Energy of Change!


**\-**
------


**We're Determined to Be the Best Place to Grow**
-------------------------------------------------


We believe that strong careers are built on a variety of experiences, strong connections, and continuous development. We're committed to providing you the tools to navigate and shape a strong career journey that aligns with a healthy work\-life balance. No two careers are the same, and yours should reflect your personal and professional goals. Your people leader and trusted mentors will support you through navigating your journey.


We also prioritize fair pay, performance\-based rewards, and wellbeing programs for you and your family. With opportunities to move across teams and functions, your career can keep evolving while sustainability stays at the core of everything we do.


**\-**
------


**Inclusion \& Diversity**
--------------------------


We are passionate about creating an inclusive work environment. By valuing the ideas and contributions of a diverse workforce, we help inspire others to grow, succeed, and raise the bar for everyone.


As an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer, GE Vernova is committed to supporting disadvantaged groups while providing equal opportunities for both GE Vernova associates and applicants alike.


*Join us at GE Vernova, where results are achieved by embracing a community of belonging.*


*\-*


Questa posizione prevede la responsabilità di guidare l’intero ciclo di realizzazione di progetti complessi di servizi per la generazione elettrica in tutta Europa, inclusi interventi di conversione, modifica, ammodernamento, riqualificazione e ricollocazione di apparecchiature presso siti esistenti dei clienti. Il Senior Project Manager funge da principale interlocutore del cliente e coordina i team di ingegneria, approvvigionamenti, produzione, logistica e cantiere, assicurando che ogni progetto venga realizzato in sicurezza, nel rispetto delle tempistiche, del budget e dei requisiti contrattuali. È inoltre responsabile dei risultati economico\-finanziari e commerciali del progetto, inclusi costi, margini, previsioni, controllo delle modifiche, rischi e gestione delle rivendicazioni contrattuali.


**Senior Project Manager – Power Services**
-------------------------------------------


**Italia \| Altre sedi: Regno Unito, Belgio, Repubblica Ceca, Irlanda, Paesi Bassi, Polonia e Svizzera**


Vuoi guidare progetti tecnicamente complessi che migliorano le prestazioni e prolungano la vita utile delle apparecchiature per la generazione elettrica in tutta Europa?


GE Vernova ricerca un Senior Project Manager con consolidata esperienza per il team Power Services. La posizione può avere sede nel Regno Unito oppure presso una delle nostre sedi in Belgio, Repubblica Ceca, Irlanda, Paesi Bassi, Polonia o Svizzera.


**GE Vernova – L’energia per cambiare il mondo**
------------------------------------------------


Con oltre 130 anni di esperienza e una comprovata capacità di innovazione, GE Vernova guida una nuova era dell’energia. Portiamo avanti l’elettrificazione del mondo, contribuendo al contempo alla sua decarbonizzazione. Il nostro nome riflette la nostra missione. “GE” racchiude un patrimonio di qualità e ingegno. “Ver” richiama i rigogliosi ecosistemi della Terra, mentre “Nova” evoca la nuova era dell’energia a minori emissioni di carbonio che stiamo contribuendo a realizzare.


Con lo sguardo rivolto al futuro, GE Vernova accelera la transizione verso un’energia affidabile, accessibile e sostenibile. Aiutiamo i clienti a sostenere le economie e a fornire l’elettricità essenziale per la salute, la sicurezza e la qualità della vita.


**Power**
---------


Il nostro portafoglio Power offre soluzioni energetiche sostenibili e più efficienti. Grazie alle nostre competenze nella generazione elettrica a gas, idroelettrica, nucleare e a vapore, aiutiamo i clienti a fornire elettricità ad abitazioni, industrie e comunità in tutto il mondo.


**Il ruolo**
------------


In qualità di Senior Project Manager, guiderai la realizzazione di progetti complessi di servizi post\-vendita all’interno della nostra organizzazione Power Services, agendo come principale rappresentante di GE Vernova e punto di riferimento del cliente durante l’intero ciclo di vita del progetto.


I progetti riguarderanno generalmente conversioni, modifiche e ammodernamenti (Conversions, Modifications and Upgrades – CM\&U), nonché interventi di riqualificazione o ricollocazione presso siti di generazione elettrica esistenti (brownfield). Potranno interessare turbine a gas industriali heavy\-duty e aeroderivate, turbine a vapore, generatori, generatori di vapore a recupero (HRSG) e le relative apparecchiature ausiliarie d’impianto (balance of plant).


Avrai la responsabilità dell’esecuzione dei progetti, coordinando i team di ingegneria, approvvigionamenti, produzione, logistica, pianificazione e cantiere per garantire una realizzazione sicura, conforme agli obblighi contrattuali e redditizia. Questi progetti possono richiedere un’intensa attività di progettazione, la piena integrazione tecnica e, in alcuni casi, l’introduzione di nuovi prodotti o soluzioni. Sarà quindi essenziale assicurare un rigoroso controllo dell’ambito di progetto, delle modifiche, dei costi e della progettazione.


A seconda delle dimensioni e della complessità, potrai gestire più progetti contemporaneamente in un contesto internazionale dinamico e caratterizzato da un’elevata visibilità organizzativa.


**Come farai la differenza**
----------------------------


* Guiderai l’esecuzione di progetti complessi di conversione, modifica, ammodernamento, riqualificazione e ricollocazione, garantendo il rispetto degli impegni contrattuali, dei costi, delle tempistiche, della qualità e dei requisiti in materia di ambiente, salute e sicurezza (EHS).
* Agirai come principale rappresentante di GE Vernova e interlocutore di riferimento per il cliente, costruendo rapporti di fiducia e promuovendo la risoluzione delle problematiche.
* Supporterai la fase di offerta e di gara, mettendo a disposizione la tua esperienza nell’esecuzione dei progetti, individuando eventuali lacune e contribuendo a garantire che la strategia di realizzazione proposta sia attuabile e solida.
* Definirai e attuerai la strategia di esecuzione del progetto, valutando criticamente le ipotesi di partenza e assicurando che siano create le condizioni per una realizzazione efficace.
* Coordinerai team interfunzionali di ingegneria, approvvigionamenti, produzione, logistica, pianificazione ed esecuzione in cantiere.
* Guiderai l’avanzamento dei programmi di progetto in collaborazione con i responsabili della pianificazione, mantenendo una chiara visibilità sulle milestone, sulle interdipendenze e sulle azioni di recupero.
* Gestirai i risultati economico\-finanziari dei progetti, inclusi costi, previsioni, margini, fatturazione, crediti verso clienti e accantonamenti per rischi.
* Interpreterai e applicherai i termini e le condizioni contrattuali durante l’intera esecuzione del progetto.
* Gestirai l’ambito di progetto, le modifiche, i rischi, le opportunità e le rivendicazioni contrattuali, coinvolgendo i livelli decisionali appropriati quando necessario e mantenendo la responsabilità della risoluzione.
* Fornirai aggiornamenti chiari sullo stato dei progetti e guiderai le riunioni di riesame con clienti, team regionali, PMO e alta direzione.
* Raccoglierai e condividerai lezioni apprese, buone pratiche e casi relativi ai costi della non qualità (Cost of Poor Quality), per migliorare la realizzazione dei progetti futuri.
* Seguirai i processi di project management applicabili a Power Services e ai progetti CM\&U.

**Requisiti specifici del ruolo**
---------------------------------


* Disponibilità e possibilità di effettuare trasferte per circa il 20% del tempo lavorativo, prevalentemente in Europa.
* Capacità di lavorare efficacemente con interlocutori di diversi Paesi, culture e fusi orari.

**Competenze per avere successo**
---------------------------------


Hai una consolidata esperienza nella guida di progetti e un percorso comprovato nella realizzazione di progetti complessi a diretto contatto con il cliente, nel settore della generazione elettrica, dei servizi energetici o in un ambito tecnico strettamente correlato.


Per questo ruolo sono richieste:


* Solida esperienza nella gestione di progetti complessi e di grandi dimensioni, chiavi in mano o di servizi, preferibilmente nel settore della generazione elettrica.
* Esperienza nella realizzazione di progetti di ammodernamento, conversione, modifica, riqualificazione, fermata impianto o attività analoghe su impianti esistenti.
* Conoscenze tecniche adeguate a collaborare efficacemente con i team di ingegneria e a comprendere le apparecchiature e le soluzioni oggetto degli interventi presso i siti dei clienti.
* Spiccate capacità di gestione delle relazioni con i clienti e sicurezza nell’affrontare problematiche complesse e situazioni che richiedono un’escalation.
* Esperienza nel coordinamento di team interfunzionali e internazionali di ingegneria, approvvigionamenti, produzione, logistica ed esecuzione in cantiere.
* Comprensione degli aspetti economico\-finanziari dei progetti, inclusi costi, margini, previsioni, fatturazione e flussi di cassa.
* Esperienza nell’interpretazione e nell’applicazione dei contratti, nella gestione delle variazioni dell’ambito di progetto e nel supporto a rivendicazioni contrattuali o negoziazioni commerciali.
* Spiccate capacità organizzative e analitiche, con attitudine a gestire più priorità contemporaneamente e a mantenere l’avanzamento delle attività in un contesto impegnativo.
* Capacità di influenzare gli stakeholder e guidare team in un’organizzazione a matrice, anche in assenza di autorità gerarchica diretta.
* Sensibilità interculturale e capacità di costruire relazioni efficaci all’interno di un’organizzazione internazionale.
* Impegno nel miglioramento continuo e nella condivisione delle lezioni apprese.

**Qualifiche**
--------------


* Laurea di primo livello in Ingegneria, discipline economico\-aziendali o altra disciplina tecnica o economica pertinente.
* È preferibile una certificazione PMP, PMLP o un’altra qualifica riconosciuta in project management.
* Le persone con un profilo particolarmente qualificato che non possiedono ancora la certificazione di project management richiesta potranno ricevere supporto per conseguirla entro un periodo concordato successivo all’assunzione.
* Disponibilità a completare la formazione continua e i rinnovi della certificazione necessari per mantenere il livello di qualifica di Project Manager previsto dal PMO.

**Sede e modalità di lavoro**
-----------------------------


Si tratta di una posizione a tempo indeterminato con sede principale nel Regno Unito. In alternativa, la persona selezionata potrà avere sede in Belgio, Repubblica Ceca, Irlanda, Paesi Bassi, Polonia o Svizzera.


Le modalità di lavoro dipenderanno dalla sede prescelta. Qualora sia disponibile un ufficio GE Vernova idoneo, sarà possibile concordare una modalità di lavoro ibrida e flessibile. In assenza di un ufficio nelle vicinanze, potrà essere valutata la possibilità di lavorare da casa.


**La nostra cultura**
---------------------


Ogni azione contribuisce a plasmare il nostro futuro. Per questo ci guida una cultura orientata all’impatto positivo, in cui ogni persona è messa nelle condizioni di crescere e raggiungere i propri obiettivi.


Rispondere all’urgente necessità di costruire un sistema elettrico più sostenibile e, al contempo, ridurre le emissioni che contribuiscono al cambiamento climatico sono priorità globali. Prendiamo seriamente la nostra responsabilità. Questa è la missione di GE Vernova: continuare a elettrificare il mondo per favorirne la prosperità e contribuire alla sua decarbonizzazione. Svolgiamo un ruolo significativo nel guidare una nuova era dell’energia.


Oggi la nostra tecnologia contribuisce a generare circa il 25% dell’elettricità mondiale e stiamo lavorando per contribuire anche alla parte restante. Se vogliamo un futuro energetico diverso, unisciti a noi e fai la differenza. Insieme, siamo l’Energia del Cambiamento!


**Vogliamo essere il posto migliore in cui crescere**
-----------------------------------------------------


Crediamo che una carriera solida si costruisca attraverso esperienze diversificate, relazioni di valore e sviluppo continuo. Ci impegniamo a fornirti gli strumenti per orientare e costruire un percorso professionale solido, in armonia con un sano equilibrio tra vita privata e lavoro. Ogni carriera è unica e la tua dovrebbe riflettere i tuoi obiettivi personali e professionali. Il tuo responsabile e mentor di fiducia ti accompagneranno lungo questo percorso.


Diamo inoltre priorità a una retribuzione equa, a riconoscimenti legati ai risultati e a programmi per il benessere tuo e della tua famiglia. Grazie alle opportunità di mobilità tra team e funzioni, la tua carriera potrà continuare a evolversi, mentre la sostenibilità rimarrà al centro di tutto ciò che facciamo.


**Inclusione e diversità**
--------------------------


Ci impegpegniamo con passione a creare un ambiente di lavoro inclusivo. Valorizzando le idee e il contributo di persone con esperienze e prospettive diverse, contribuiamo a ispirare la crescita, il successo e il raggiungimento di standard sempre più elevati per tutti.


In qualità di datore di lavoro che promuove le pari opportunità e adotta azioni positive, GE Vernova si impegna a sostenere i gruppi svantaggiati, garantendo pari opportunità sia al proprio personale sia alle persone che si candidano.


*Unisciti a GE Vernova, dove raggiungiamo i risultati promuovendo una comunità in cui ogni persona si sente parte integrante.*


**Additional Information**
==========================

Overview
  
  

Entrerai nella struttura di Organizzazione e Processi Digitali con l'obiettivo di supportare l'evoluzione dei processi e del modello operativo aziendale partecipando attivamente a progetti di business, strategici e di trasformazione, identificando opportunità di miglioramento.
  
  

Quali saranno le tue attività
  
Analizzare e mappare i processi aziendali end\-to\-end individuando opportunità di semplificazione, efficientamento e automazione.
  
Disegnare e implementare modelli operativi innovativi in coerenza con gli obiettivi di business.
  
Identificare opportunità di innovazione per migliorare efficacia ed efficienza dei processi.
  
Partecipare a programmi strategici e gestire progetti con impatti cross\-funzionali.
  
Coordinare stakeholder business, IT, Operations, Risk, Compliance.
  
Pianificare roadmap, milestone e identificare possibile rischi e interdipendenze progettuali.
  
Predisporre documentazione progettuale, steering committee e reportistica direzionale.
  
Monitorare avanzamento lavori, benefici attesi e risultati conseguiti.

almeno 3 anni di esperienza preferibilmente in società di consulenza o start up innovative o gruppi finanziari o assicurativi, in ruoli di Process Management, Organizational Transformation, Project Management.
  
laurea triennale o magistrale in Ingegneria Gestionale, Economia, Management, Informatica o discipline affini.
  
conoscenza della gestione di progetti in contesti assicurativi, finanziari.
  
conoscenze di Process Mapping e Business Process Management (BPM), Program e Project Management, Business Analysis e Change Management.
  
conoscenza di metodologie Agile e Waterfall.
  
ottima conoscenza della suite Microsoft 365 (power Point, Excel, Teams, Word, etc)
  
conoscenza di Power BI.
  
conoscenza della lingua inglese (almeno B1\).

Retribuzione annua lorda a partire da 39\.000 €
  
Il Gruppo prevede una componente variabile della remunerazione così come disciplinata dalle Politiche di Remunerazione consultabili sul sito di Gruppo

Iniziative di sviluppo professionale a supporto della crescita delle nostre persone

Vantaggi sui prodotti e servizi bancari del Gruppo

Intesa Sanpaolo Assicurazioni offre soluzioni assicurative innovative e personalizzate. title: HSE Specialist
description:
Responsabilità del ruolo

L’**E\&HS Specialist** è responsabile di garantire la conformità dell’organizzazione alla normativa vigente in materia di salute, sicurezza e ambiente, con particolare riferimento al **D.Lgs. 81/08** e al **D.Lgs. 152/06**, assicurando al contempo l’applicazione degli standard e delle procedure aziendali.

La figura opera a stretto contatto con i dipartimenti di **Produzione, Manutenzione e Quality Assurance (QA)**, supportando l’implementazione e il monitoraggio delle procedure operative in un ambiente altamente regolamentato.

Avrà inoltre un ruolo attivo nella promozione della cultura della prevenzione, nella gestione dei rischi HSE e nel miglioramento continuo degli standard di salute, sicurezza e tutela ambientale.

Ambiente e Rischio di Incidente Rilevante

* **Gestione delle emissioni e degli scarichi:** monitorare il rispetto delle autorizzazioni ambientali, inclusa l’Autorizzazione Unica Ambientale (AUA), supervisionando i controlli analitici relativi alle emissioni in atmosfera e agli scarichi idrici.
* **Gestione dei rifiuti:** garantire la corretta classificazione dei rifiuti secondo i codici EER, nonché le attività di stoccaggio, movimentazione e smaltimento dei rifiuti speciali e pericolosi derivanti dai processi produttivi farmaceutici.
* **Rischio di incidente rilevante:** supportare la gestione e il monitoraggio degli aspetti HSE connessi alla presenza e alla gestione di sostanze pericolose, in coordinamento con le funzioni aziendali e i consulenti di riferimento.

Salute e Sicurezza sul Lavoro – D.Lgs. 81/08

* **Valutazione dei rischi:** collaborare con il consulente esterno nell’aggiornamento del DVR e delle valutazioni dei rischi specifici, tra cui rischio chimico e biologico, ATEX, movimentazione dei carichi e rumore.
* **Supporto operativo:** elaborare e aggiornare procedure operative e SOP HSE, assicurandone l’integrazione con le procedure e gli standard GMP applicabili allo stabilimento.
* **Infortuni e Near Miss:** gestire il processo di registrazione, analisi e reportistica degli infortuni, degli incidenti e dei near miss, contribuendo all’individuazione delle azioni correttive e preventive.
* **Permessi di lavoro:** gestire e verificare i sistemi di Work Permit per attività ad alto rischio, quali lavori in quota, lavori in spazi confinati, lavori a caldo e interventi su linee o impianti contenenti sostanze chimiche.
* **Gestione delle ditte esterne:** coordinare e monitorare gli aspetti HSE relativi alle imprese appaltatrici, con particolare riferimento agli adempimenti previsti dall’art. 26 e dal Titolo IV del D.Lgs. 81/08\.

Formazione e Sorveglianza Sanitaria

* **Piani formativi:** contribuire alla definizione e alla pianificazione dei corsi di formazione obbligatori e specifici in materia di salute, sicurezza e ambiente, con particolare attenzione alla gestione delle sostanze pericolose e delle emergenze.
* **Formazione HSE:** gestire il processo di onboarding e di formazione HSE del personale neoassunto, degli interinali e delle ditte esterne operanti presso lo stabilimento.
* **Gestione appalti:** supportare la gestione della documentazione HSE relativa alle imprese terze, inclusi DUVRI, qualificazione e verifica dei requisiti delle ditte appaltatrici.
* **Sorveglianza sanitaria:** interfacciarsi con il Medico Competente e con le funzioni aziendali coinvolte per gli aspetti di salute e sicurezza connessi alle attività lavorative.

Sistemi di Gestione e Audit

* **Sistemi di gestione:** applicare e supportare il mantenimento dei sistemi di gestione conformi agli standard **ISO 14001 – Ambiente** e **ISO 45001 – Salute e Sicurezza sul Lavoro**.
* **Audit e verifiche ispettive:** partecipare, a supporto del team HSE, agli audit interni e alle verifiche da parte degli enti e delle autorità competenti, quali **ASL, ARPA e Vigili del Fuoco**.
* **Miglioramento continuo:** contribuire all’identificazione di opportunità di miglioramento e all’implementazione di azioni correttive e preventive per il continuo miglioramento delle performance HSE.

Requisiti e competenze

**Formazione**

* Laurea in **Ingegneria Ambientale, Ingegneria della Sicurezza** o discipline scientifiche/tecniche affini.
* Costituisce titolo preferenziale una formazione specifica come **ASPP/RSPP**, con possesso dei relativi moduli formativi previsti dalla normativa vigente.
* Costituisce titolo preferenziale la formazione in materia di **GMP, gestione delle emergenze, ATEX e rischio chimico/biologico**.

**Esperienza professionale**

* **2–5 anni di esperienza** maturata in ambito HSE, preferibilmente all’interno di aziende farmaceutiche, chimiche, manifatturiere o comunque caratterizzate da contesti produttivi altamente regolamentati.
* Esperienza nella gestione degli aspetti di **salute, sicurezza e ambiente** e nella collaborazione con consulenti, enti esterni e funzioni aziendali.
* Costituisce titolo preferenziale l’esperienza nella gestione di **audit, autorizzazioni ambientali, DVR, permessi di lavoro e imprese appaltatrici**.

**Competenze tecniche**

* Conoscenza della normativa italiana in materia di **Salute, Sicurezza e Ambiente**, con particolare riferimento al D.Lgs. 81/08 e al D.Lgs. 152/06\.
* Conoscenza dei principali strumenti e metodologie di **risk assessment** e gestione dei rischi HSE.
* Conoscenza dei processi di gestione di **infortuni, near miss, non conformità e azioni correttive/preventive**.
* Conoscenza dei sistemi di gestione **ISO 14001 e ISO 45001**.
* Familiarità con procedure e requisiti **GMP**, preferibilmente maturata in ambiente farmaceutico.
* Conoscenza delle procedure relative alla gestione delle **ditte esterne, DUVRI, Titolo IV e art. 26 del D.Lgs. 81/08**.
* Buona conoscenza degli strumenti informatici e del pacchetto **Microsoft Office**.
* **Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese**, sia scritta sia parlata.

**Competenze personali**

We are seeking an experienced Global Study Lead (GSL) to provide strategic and operational leadership for complex global clinical studies.

  

This is a senior study leadership position with end\-to\-end accountability for clinical study delivery, from study initiation through to study close\-out and archiving. You will define the operational strategy, lead cross\-functional study teams, and ensure studies are delivered to the required timelines, quality, budget and regulatory standards.

  

As a key member of the Study Leadership Team, you will represent Clinical Operations and work closely with Clinical, Statistics and other cross\-functional partners to drive decisions, manage risk and ensure successful study delivery.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Lead the operational strategy and end\-to\-end delivery of one or more global clinical studies.
* Own study timelines, budget, quality, risks and key operational deliverables.
* Provide strategic leadership to global, cross\-functional study teams and drive timely decision\-making.
* Represent Clinical Operations within the Study Leadership Team and act as the senior escalation point for operational issues.
* Translate clinical development and asset strategy into clear study\-level operational plans.
* Lead proactive study risk identification, mitigation and issue resolution.
* Ensure robust feasibility, study planning and operational execution.
* Provide strategic operational input into protocols, informed consent forms and other key study documents.
* Oversee CROs and other external vendors, including vendor selection, performance management and escalation where deliverables are at risk.
* Ensure studies remain compliant with ICH\-GCP, applicable regulations, SOPs and inspection\-readiness requirements.
* Lead study financial planning, forecasting and budget management.
* Communicate study progress, risks, decisions and recommendations effectively to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Champion innovative approaches to clinical trial delivery, including decentralised trial approaches, technology, automation and AI\-enabled ways of working.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across Clinical Operations.

### **About You**

  

You will be an accomplished clinical operations professional with significant experience leading complex global clinical studies within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry.

  

You will bring:

* A Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline.
* Extensive experience in global clinical study delivery, ideally across multiple phases, indications and geographic regions.
* Proven experience holding end\-to\-end accountability for complex global clinical trials.
* Strong experience leading global cross\-functional teams within a matrix environment.
* Demonstrated ownership of study timelines, budgets, risks, quality and operational strategy.
* Significant experience overseeing CROs and third\-party vendors, including performance management and issue resolution.
* In\-depth knowledge of ICH\-GCP, global regulatory requirements and clinical development processes.
* Strong project and financial management capabilities.
* The ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive decisions in complex, fast\-paced environments.
* Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation and conflict\-management skills.
* Experience proactively identifying and resolving risks that could impact clinical programmes.

### **Highly Desirable**

  

Experience in one or more of the following would be particularly valuable:

* Phase II and/or Phase III global clinical trials.
* Adaptive or other innovative trial designs.
* Decentralised clinical trials (DCTs).
* Platform, umbrella or basket studies.
* Technology\-enabled clinical trial delivery, automation or AI/ML.
* Working with investigators, external experts and regulatory authorities.

title: Group International Tax Expert
description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.


Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns **25** plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in **26** countries, and employs approximately **4,700** people.


Shares of the parent company Davide Campari \- Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001\. Campari Group is today the sixth\-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

 **About the Role*** The Group International Tax Expert will join the Group Tax Department and play a key role in supporting global tax planning activities and international tax matters, including corporate restructurings and M\&A transactions.
* This is an exciting opportunity to join the Group Tax function of a multinational organisation with Italian roots, a strong international footprint, and a successful growth journey driven by both organic expansion and strategic acquisitions across global markets.
* The ideal candidate brings a solid understanding of international tax and regulatory frameworks, combined with strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across a complex, global business environment.


**Mission \& Objectives*** Campari Group is committed to maintaining and continuously enhancing tax compliance across its global operations, ensuring alignment with both the Group Transfer Pricing Policy and the evolving international taxation framework, including the OECD BEPS Actions.
* In this role, you will contribute to strengthening the Group’s tax governance, supporting strategic business initiatives, and ensuring robust compliance with international tax regulations.


**Key Responsibilities*** Reporting to and working closely with the Group Sr. Tax Director, you will:
* Support global tax projects, including Group restructurings, M\&A transactions, cross\-border initiatives, and other projects requiring international tax expertise and project management skills.
* Provide technical support on international tax matters, including permanent establishment issues, withholding taxes, financing structures, and intercompany transactions.
* Assist in the design and implementation of global tax governance frameworks and tax strategies.
* Identify, assess, and mitigate international tax risks arising from the Group’s operations and strategic projects.
* Manage relationships with external tax advisors and coordinate cross\-functional stakeholders involved in international initiatives.
* Support the drafting and review of intercompany agreements and collaborate closely with the Transfer Pricing team to ensure consistency and alignment of tax positions.
* Proactively contribute to the implementation of the Group Tax Guidelines, helping to enhance overall tax compliance across the organisation.


**Key Stakeholder Relationships**
Internal* Tax teams across the Group
* Regional and local Finance departments
* Global Service Center
* Group IT
* Group Product Supply Chain
* Sales \& Marketing teams
* Corporate Finance
* Legal
* Business Development
* Other support functions on a project basis


External* Tax advisors and consultants

 **Experience*** 3 to 6 years of corporate tax experience gained either within a multinational corporation or a legal/tax consulting firm serving multinational companies.
* Experience within the Fast\-Moving Consumer Goods (FMCG) or Fashion \& Luxury sectors is considered a strong advantage.

 **Qualifications*** Degree in Law, Economics, or Business Administration, with a specialisation or dissertation focused on International Taxation.
* Fluency in English and a good knowledge of Italian are essential.
* Additional language skills are considered a plus.


**Key Competencies*** Strong project management capabilities
* Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills
* Ability to collaborate effectively across functions and cultures
* High level of integrity and professional ethics
* Influential leadership style
* Pragmatic, hands\-on approach with strong problem\-solving skills
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure
* Innovative mindset with a focus on continuous improvement


**Technical Skills*** Solid knowledge of international tax and regulatory systems
* Strong analytical and tax research capabilities, including the use of tax databases
* Ability to combine technical tax expertise with practical application of international tax rules
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and PowerPoint
* Good working knowledge of SAP


**Additional Information*** Availability to travel up to 20% of the time.

 **Compensation \& Benefits**


The indicative annual gross base salary for this position ranges between €55,000 and €65,000, depending on the candidate's experience, skills, and overall profile.The role is classified under the CCNL Alimentare collective labour agreement – Impiegato. The position might also include a variable compensation component and a benefits package in line with applicable company policies.  

Join us and help shape the international tax strategy of a truly global organisation while supporting key business initiatives and transformational projects worldwide. **Our commitment to Diversity \& Inclusion:**

description:
